rows.label: bf01090100_0030
rows.name:
Fresh as ever... No, I mean
spirited as ever, mo.

rows.label: bf01090100_0040
rows.name:
Yeah, I guess. So, what
do you need? A new job?

rows.label: bf01090100_0050
rows.name:
Something like that, mo.
By the way, Rex...

rows.label: bf01090100_0060
rows.name:
You were from Iyasaki Village in
the Liberalitas Archipelago, right, mo?

rows.label: bf01090100_0070
rows.name: Yeah, that's right. Why d'you ask?

rows.label: bf01090100_0080
rows.name:
Go to the chairman's office
right away, mo.

rows.label: bf01090100_0100
rows.name: Chairman Bahn is calling for you, mo.
